title: Download the PDF attachment of a Meine AOK message
description: Opens the message whose row text contains the given text and downloads its PDF attachment. The attachment is served from the portal's API origin, which needs level read as well (ADR 0018). The portal marks the message as read. Starts on a folder list; run aok/list-postbox first to see the rows.

params.name: title
params.description: Text of the row, as aok/list-postbox lists it (a substring is enough).
